_comment: Drives test/klippy/multi_mcu_avr_xmcu.test under the EMULATOR multi-bridge fan-out with stepper_z on the second MCU. tick_mode keeps the bridges in lockstep with klippy's reactor. auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires each stepper's endstop after 100 step edges so G28 completes; the fixture pusher routes the X/Y step_trigger commands to the main `mcu` bridge and Z's step_trigger to the `other` bridge based on each pin's MCU prefix.
